event_chain.summary: Access to pump control interface (method not disclosed)
Control panel screenshots and system layouts taken and posted

summary: In late March 2026 a threat actor calling itself the 'Infrastructure Destruction Squad' (also 'Dark Engine') claimed to have gained administrative access to the control interface of the hydraulic pump system that protects Piazza San Marco in Venice from flooding (part of Italy's flood risk reduction system). In early April the group posted screenshots of control panels, system layouts and valve states on Telegram, claimed it could disable the defenses, and offered to sell root access for $600. No physical impact was reported.

victim.victim_id: Italian Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport (San Marco flood risk reduction system)
